source.notice: Traditional sayings, carried orally. The sayings themselves belong to nobody, so none is quoted from a published collection — each is written from widely circulated wording and attributed to the language it comes from rather than to an author.

sayings.text: A person is a person through other people.
The road is asked of those who went ahead.
Hands wash one another.
The leopard eats by its spots.
The foot has no nose — it will carry you back to where you were unkind.
The bird builds its nest with another bird's feathers.
The beauty of a home is seen by those passing through.
You ask about the buffalo from those who went ahead.
A person is a person through other people.

sayings.original: Mmangwana o tshwara thipa ka bohaleng
sayings.text: A child's mother takes hold of the knife by the blade.

sayings.original: Tau tsa hloka seboka di siilwe ke nare
sayings.text: Lions that lacked unity were outrun by a buffalo.

sayings.original: Bana ba motho ba ngwathelana hlogo ya tsie
sayings.text: Siblings share the head of a locust, however little there is.
Hands wash one another.
The heart eats what it loves.

sayings.original: Mphemphe o a lapisa, motho o kgonwa ke sa hae
sayings.text: Always borrowing wears you out; a person is satisfied by what is their own.
A debt does not rot.
To travel is to see.

sayings.original: Sejo se monate ha se jewe se le mong
sayings.text: Good food is not eaten alone.
Where there is peace there is plenty.

sayings.original: Moroto o mong ha o kgaole noka
sayings.text: One person's water does not dam a river.
No cunning one ever licked their own back.
The bull is among the calves.
The grass pricks while it is still growing.
A good garment is sewn in the company of others.
The child who does not cry dies on its mother's back.
Go on then, dove — they will pluck you further ahead.

sayings.original: Kgetsi ya tsie e kgonwa ka go tshwaraganelwa
sayings.text: A bag of locusts is carried by holding it together.
Jealousy does not build a village.

sayings.original: Botlhale jwa phala bo tswa phalaneng
sayings.text: The wisdom of the impala comes from the young impala.

sayings.original: Mphiri o tee ga o lle
sayings.text: One bangle does not jingle.
